text_block_list.text:
On my day off, I headed to the racecourse
to watch some races for research, when――

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Hang in thereee! You can close the gap, you've got this!
Dig deeper! Don't be afraid!!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Don't give up! Don't let your spirit break!!
The goal post is right before your eyeees!!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Wait... oh my?!
Aren't you—!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... Please forgive me
for showing you such an unsightly side of myself.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Still, once we hit the fourth corner,
I just can't help getting swept up in the excitement...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
It's the moment the race shifts dramatically, after all,
and the expressions on the Umamusume change completely, don't they?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
I just can't resist that feeling
when the crowd gets all hyped up~...!
choice_data_list: I think I get what you mean.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Are you serious?!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Whoops... *ahem*.
No, no, I'm doing it again...

Despite saying so, Miss Tazuna looks as though
she still has plenty more she'd like to share, but—
choice_data_list: I'd love to hear more about that!
Well, I have work to do, so I should be going...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Are you sure?!
It's such a crucial time, aren't you terribly busy...?
choice_data_list: Today was a day off to begin with, after all.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Trainer-san...!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: ――Fufu,

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Right! It feels a bit awkward to just stand here chatting, so how about we discuss it over a meal?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: To tell the truth, there's a shop nearby that I've had my eye on for a while now...!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Fufu... To think I'd get to talk with you one-on-one like this, Trainer—I'm truly honored!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
...So, about that!
Getting right to the point, about the race earlier――!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
――Aah, I completely understand, yes!
Seeing them strive so hard toward their dreams
is just so endlessly inspiring……!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Still, the encouraging voices of the fans
become the very power that drives an Umamusume forward...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Looking at it that way, races truly create
such wonderful mutual synergy!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Speaking of which, in last year's race too—

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: The Derby... the Derby is truly wonderful, isn't it?! Though, of course, every single GⅠ is a magnificent race worthy of the utmost reverence.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: I personally hold a special attachment to the Nippon Derby.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: To tell the truth, I make sure to watch it live every single year――

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
—Wait, gah!?
Look at the time...!!
choice_data_list: Night fell before we knew it...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Unlike the students,
neither of us is bound by a curfew...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: ――Just once more, could I?

And so, even after moving to another place,
Tazuna-san and I continued our passionate talk
about Umamusume and races――

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: ...It is morning, isn't it.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Umm... I'm terribly sorry for dragging you into this...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Still... um.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: —It was fun, so very fun!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
To be frank, from the very moment I laid eyes on you,
I could tell you were overflowing with passion for Umamusume and racing, but――

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
To be able to talk through it in depth like this...
...Fufu, it's been a wonderful time♪

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: If it's okay with you, please let's chat again sometime!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, but let's try our best to avoid pulling all-nighters, okay?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: It's about time it, you know... starts catching up to your body.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Whoaaa...

And so, stifling our yawns all the way,
we made our way back to the Academy.
――I felt as though I had somehow grown a little closer to Tazuna-san.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Ah, r-right, of course!
It's an important time, so you must be busy.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Um... Well, I shall take my leave as well.
I look forward to seeing you at the academy!
And with that, I parted ways with Tazuna-san...
